openapoc_modinfo.name: Night City
openapoc_modinfo.author: Joseph
openapoc_modinfo.description: Neon-noir regrade of Mega-Primus. The cityscape renders through three time-of-day palettes; regrading those restyles every tile at once - concrete and shadow go cool blue-steel, bright entries become neon light sources, and daylight is pulled down to an overcast dusk. No sprites are modified.
